contract.name: PresentationCueAxisModalExpansion
contract.grain: population x current presentation (lure or bait state)
contract.semantics: per population and current presentation: each cue axis reads ONE presentation-side computed fact and does a unary profile lookup; the resulting Fit is one parallel input into the fixed combine of the existing Feeding / Reaction channel

profile_slots.meaning: 味型/信息素强度→触发适配
拟饵/环境电场特征→触发适配

fact_atoms.fact_semantics: 当前呈现的味型/信息素强度（上游呈现侧计算事实）
拟饵电场特征（上游呈现侧计算事实）

combine.joins: each axis Fit enters the existing RR-T1 Feeding / Reaction channel fixed combine as one parallel input; no new channel and no new combine topology
combine.rule: per presentation: lookup(BaitScentIntensity, @ScentCueProfile) -> ScentCueFit; lookup(LureElectricField, @ElectroFieldProfile) -> ElectroFieldCueFit; each Fit joins the channel result by the template-fixed rule of the existing RR-T1 channel; the combine math itself is UNDEFINED on the mechanism side and this artifact delivers the boundary only
